issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the UML in the problem statement declares the method to return a double, but the reference solution implements it as returning an int. The template file does not provide a signature (it has a TODO), so a student following the UML will implement a double-returning method while the provided solution (and any instructor tests derived from it) currently use an int. This mismatch can cause confusion and may lead to test or compatibility problems (e.g., failing type-based assertions or unexpected integer division).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) update the solution and template to use 'public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor()' and compute using double division (e.g. 'return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors();'), or (B) update the UML in problem_statement.md to specify 'int' as the return type. Also ensure the template replaces the TODO with the chosen signature and that any tests expect the same return type.
